properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 21 at 3:39PM PDT until October 21 at 7:15PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Far southern Los Angeles County in southwestern
California...

* WHEN...Until 715 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 338 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Long Beach, Torrance, Rancho Palos Verdes, Carson, Port of Los
Angeles, Rolling Hills, Wilmington, Harbor City, Los Angeles
Harbor, Compton, Gardena, Hawthorne, Bellflower, Signal Hill,
Lawndale and Paramount.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 715 PM PDT THIS EVENING
